explication: httpSMS uses an Android phone as an SMS gateway: API clients submit messages, the API queues a phone notification, the Android app sends the SMS and reports its status. The web dashboard provides message, thread, contact, billing, and phone-management workflows. The graph also includes documented webhook forwarding and API-side event handling. Some source excerpts are partial and many modules are unsampled, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted; optional integrations are shown separately.
